sections.title: NRN PLAINS TO UPPER MS VALLEY
sections.text: UPPER RIDGE HAS BEEN SUPPRESSED TO SOME EXTENT ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS AS A COUPLE OF LOW AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGHS TRACK EAST ALONG THE U.S./CANADA BORDER. THE LEADING SHORTWAVE TROUGH...CURRENTLY NORTH OF MN...HAS INDUCED A SFC CYCLONE OVER WRN ONTARIO THIS MORNING. A COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM THE ONTARIO SFC LOW SWWD ACROSS NWRN MN AND THEN BISECTS SD FROM NE TO SW. ISOLATED CLUSTERS OF TSTMS NEAR DLH ATTM WERE OCCURRING WITHIN A NARROW CORRIDOR OF WARM ADVECTION AHEAD OF THE COLD FRONT. FARTHER WEST...MODEST ASCENT WITH THE NEXT SHORTWAVE TROUGH WAS ALREADY CONTRIBUTING TO MORE WIDESPREAD ELEVATED CONVECTION TO THE NORTH OF THE SFC FRONT AND LEE LOW OVER ERN MT AND WRN ND. HEIGHT FALLS WITH THIS NEXT SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL ACT TO FURTHER SUPPRESS THE UPPER RIDGE AXIS ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS AND RESULT IN A BELT OF STRONGER WNWLY MID LEVEL FLOW SPREADING SEWD ACROSS THE DAKOTAS/MN AND NRN WI THROUGH TONIGHT. MORNING SOUNDINGS ACROSS THE NRN PLAINS DEPICT STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES AROUND 9C/KM IN THE 700-500MB LAYER. BASE OF THE ELEVATED WARM LAYER WILL ACT TO CAP SFC-BASED CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT UNTIL LATER THIS AFTERNOON WHEN THE COMBINATION OF WEAK HEIGHT FALLS AND STRONG HEATING

sections.title: OZARKS TO TN VALLEY
sections.text: THE PERSISTENT MID/UPPER LEVEL TROUGH ACROSS THE EAST WILL REMAIN INFUSED WITH RELATIVELY HIGH MOISTURE BUT GENERALLY WEAK LAPSE RATES AND MID LEVEL FLOW AOB 20KT. A BAND OF SOMEWHAT STRONGER NWLY MID LEVEL FLOW EXISTS BETWEEN THE TROUGH IN THE EAST AND THE SCNTRL U.S. ANTICYCLONE...ROUGHLY FROM KS TO THE TN VALLEY. A DECAYING/RESIDUAL FRONTAL ZONE WAS SITUATED FROM SOUTH OF THE OH RIVER WWD ACROSS THE MID/LOWER MS VALLEY WHERE IT INTERSECTS WITH THE PLAINS CAPPING INVERSION AND RESIDUAL WARM FRONT AND COMPOSITE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY...FROM AR SSEWD TO THE NCNTRL GULF COAST. WEAK MCVS EMBEDDED WITHIN THE NWLY FLOW STREAM MAY ACT TO ENHANCE LIFT/LOW LEVEL CONVERGENCE ALONG THE WEAK BOUNDARIES ACROSS THESE AREAS RESULTING IN SCATTERED MULTICELL STORMS WITH SOME POSSIBILITY OF A FEW DAMAGING WIND EVENTS OR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL.

sections.title: SOUTHWEST TO ROCKIES
sections.text: WHILE PROSPECTS FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS APPEARS LOW...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY DEPICTS MID/UPPER LEVEL MOISTURE PLUME WILL CONTINUE TO STREAM AROUND THE NWRN PERIPHERY OF THE ANTICYCLONE FROM THE LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY TO THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. HIGHEST PW VALUES IN THIS PLUME RESIDE ACROSS SRN CA AND SWRN AZ WHERE A SLOW MOVING MCV WILL LIKELY ENHANCE DEEP CONVECTION AND HEAVY RAIN POTENTIAL AGAIN TODAY. ADDITIONAL WIDESPREAD DIURNAL CONVECTION WILL OCCUR FROM ERN NV ACROSS THE ROCKIES. ..CARBIN/PETERS/ROGERS.. 08/01/2012

sections.title: TN VALLEY/NRN GULF STATES
sections.text: SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE RECENTLY INTENSIFIED ALONG WIND SHIFT ARCING FROM SERN KY...ALONG THE TN BORDER INTO WRN KY. LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES HAVE STEEPENED SIGNIFICANTLY AHEAD OF THIS ACTIVITY AND WITH MLCAPE VALUES ON THE ORDER OF 3000 J/KG THERE IS REASON TO BELIEVE THAT UPDRAFTS WILL CONTINUE TO MATURE/INTENSIFY WITHIN MODEST NWLY FLOW REGIME. FOR THIS REASON HAVE INCREASED SEVERE PROBS FOR SEWD-MOVING CONVECTION. ADDITIONALLY...CONVECTION IS BEGINNING TO INTENSIFY ALONG LEADING EDGE OF OLD CONVECTIVE DEBRIS ACROSS PORTIONS OF WRN TN INTO NRN MS. AIRMASS HAS WARMED SIGNIFICANTLY ACROSS THIS PORTION OF THE NRN GULF REGION WITH SFC TEMPERATURES WELL INTO THE MID 90S. SUFFICIENT MID LEVEL FLOW EXTENDS AROUND THE PERIPHERY OF THE UPPER HIGH ACROSS THIS REGION AND MULTI-CELL ORGANIZATION IS POSSIBLE AS THIS ACTIVITY SPREADS SOUTHEAST. REF SWOMCD 1671 FOR FURTHER INFO.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: ONLY MINOR CHANGES HAVE BEEN MADE TO EARLIER OUTLOOK WITH LOW SEVERE PROBS ADDED TO NERN MT/NWRN ND TO ACCOUNT FOR VERY ISOLATED TSTM ACTIVITY THAT WILL SPREAD SEWD FROM SK ALONG BOUNDARY. HAIL IS THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH THESE STORMS. ..DARROW.. 08/01/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT WED AUG 01 2012/

sections.title: SOUTHWEST TO ROCKIES
sections.text: WHILE PROSPECTS FOR ORGANIZED SEVERE STORMS APPEARS LOW...WATER VAPOR IMAGERY DEPICTS MID/UPPER LEVEL MOISTURE PLUME WILL CONTINUE TO STREAM AROUND THE NWRN PERIPHERY OF THE ANTICYCLONE FROM THE LOWER CO RIVER VALLEY TO THE CNTRL HIGH PLAINS. ADDITIONAL WIDESPREAD DIURNAL CONVECTION WILL OCCUR FROM ERN NV ACROSS THE ROCKIES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE POTENTIAL EXISTS FOR ELEVATED STORMS CURRENTLY LOCATED OVER NWRN WI AND FAR WRN UPPER MI TO TURN SEWD WITHIN NWLY FLOW ALOFT AND POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AS THIS ACTIVITY BECOMES SURFACE BASED OVER NRN INTO CENTRAL WI. ISOLATED HAIL WILL REMAIN A THREAT...ESPECIALLY WITH THE ONGOING ELEVATED STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TRENDS IN LATE MORNING-EARLY AFTERNOON REGIONAL RADAR IMAGERY INDICATED ISOLATED STRONGER STORMS PROGRESSING EWD/ESEWD THROUGH NRN WI AND ADJACENT COUNTIES OF WRN UPPER MI. OBJECTIVE ANALYSES SUGGEST THIS ACTIVITY CURRENTLY REMAINS AT LEAST MARGINALLY ELEVATED DUE TO SOME INHIBITION OVER THIS AREA. HOWEVER...THE MODIFIED 12Z GRB SOUNDING WITH CURRENT CENTRAL WI READINGS IN THE LOWER-MID 80S REDUCES THIS INHIBITION SUGGESTING SURFACE BASED STORMS COULD EVOLVE FAIRLY SOON. A FEED OF MODERATE INSTABILITY PER A 30 KT WLY LLJ WILL BE MAINTAINED INTO NRN WI. THIS COMBINED WITH LOWER TROPOSPHERIC WAA...STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-40 KT WILL SUPPORT AN ENVIRONMENT FAVORABLE FOR ADDITIONAL TSTMS AND AN INCREASE IN THE SEVERE WEATHER THREAT. STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES PER SURFACE HEATING WILL BOOST DCAPE VALUES WHICH ARE ALREADY RANGING FROM 1500-1700 J/KG. 12Z NSSL-WRF 4 KM SUGGESTS THE ONGOING ELEVATED STORMS AND NEW ACTIVITY DEVELOPING OVER WEST CENTRAL WI INTO CENTRAL MN WILL TURN SEWD WITH AN INCREASING POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS. THIS TREND APPEARS TO BE STARTING AS ONGOING STORMS ARE TRANSITIONING INTO A LINEAR MODE...AND A WATCH WILL BE NEEDED SHORTLY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TSTM COVERAGE IS EXPECTED TO INCREASE OVER PARTS OF MIDDLE TN AND THE CNTRL APPALACHIANS THIS AFTERNOON. A FEW CLUSTERS MAY EVENTUALLY DEVELOP...POSING A RISK FOR STRONG-SVR WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. A WW MAY NEED TO BE CONSIDERED. PARTS OF THIS REGION WILL ALSO BE UPGRADED TO A SLIGHT RISK AT 20Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE LOOP SHOWS BUILDING CU/TOWERING CU FIELD NEAR THE TN/KY BORDER...AND ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF FAR SWRN VA...AS STRONG HEATING HAS ERODED MOST CINH. THREE MESOSCALE FEATURES OF INTEREST ARE APPARENT...INCLUDING 1) A WEAK COLD FRONT EXTENDING ACROSS SRN KY...2) A LINE OF CU ORIENTED SSW TO NNE ACROSS ERN TN ASSOCIATED WITH A DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE FROM EARLIER TODAY AND WEAK UPSLOPE FLOW...AND 3) A WEAK UPPER IMPULSE NOTED ON WATER VAPOR IMAGERY ENTERING ERN KY. EACH OF THESE FEATURES SHOULD PROVIDE A FOCUS FOR ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT OVER THE NEXT 1-2 HRS. RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE /WITH SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE UPPER 60S-LOWER 70S/ IS YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES OF 1500-2500 J/KG...DESPITE RELATIVELY WARM MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURE PROFILES. ADDITIONALLY...MODERATE MIDLEVEL FLOW /30-35 KTS/ WILL BE SUPPORTIVE FOR ONE OR MORE ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS TO EVOLVE AS TSTMS CONSOLIDATE/MERGE...PROPAGATING TOWARDS THE SSE. THESE CONDITIONS WILL SUPPORT A THREAT FOR DMGG WINDS AND LARGE HAIL...AND MAY REQUIRE ISSUANCE OF A WW SHOULD CONVECTIVE TRENDS CONTINUE TO INCREASE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED DMGG WIND THREAT MAY DEVELOP ACROSS CNTRL/NERN MS AND PARTS OF NWRN AL THIS AFTERNOON. TSTMS HAVE BEEN INCREASING IN COVERAGE IN PROXIMITY TO A SSE MOVING MCV NOW ENTERING NW MS. THERE IS SOME UNCERTAINTY REGARDING COVERAGE OF THE THREAT...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR POSSIBLE WW ISSUANCE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SATELLITE LOOP SHOWS A MCV AND ASSOCIATED CONVECTIVE DEBRIS CLOUDINESS OVERSPREADING PARTS OF THE MS RIVER VALLEY...WITH AN INCREASE IN CONVECTION OVER THE PAST COUPLE HRS ACROSS NERN MS. SFC TEMPERATURES HAVE HEATED UP INTO THE UPPER 90S TO NEAR 100 F ACROSS NERN MS...WHILE DEWPOINTS HAVE REMAINED IN THE 70S...RESULTING IN MLCAPE VALUES AOA 2000 J/KG. MIDLEVEL FLOW APPEARS TO BE SOMEWHAT MARGINAL FOR STORM ORGANIZATION...THOUGH ONE OR MORE MULTICELL CLUSTERS MAY STILL DEVELOP THROUGH STORM MERGERS WITHIN AREA OF FOCUSED ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE MCV. STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND OBJECTIVELY ANALYZED DCAPE VALUES GREATER THAN 1500 J/KG WILL BE SUPPORTIVE FOR ISOLATED DMGG WIND GUSTS. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER COVERAGE OF WIND THREAT WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR WW ISSUANCE...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WW ISSUANCE IS LIKELY THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS PARTS OF CENTRAL AND ERN SD AND SWD INTO NRN/CENTRAL NEB. LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS. TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ACROSS CENTRAL INTO ERN SD THIS AFTERNOON...WITH ADDITIONAL TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALSO UNDERWAY OVER THE NEB PANHANDLE. THIS LATTER ACTIVITY WILL MOVE EWD INTO CENTRAL AND NRN PARTS OF NEB.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: REGIONAL RADARS INDICATED AN INCREASE IN TSTM DEVELOPMENT ALONG AND N OF THE WRN EXTENT OF A SURFACE FRONT...WHICH GENERALLY EXTENDED FROM EAST CENTRAL SD TO AN AREA OF LOW PRESSURE INVOF OF PHP/PIR. ADDITIONAL STORMS WERE INCREASING IN COVERAGE AND INTENSITY ALONG A DRY LINE EXTENDING SSWWD INTO THE ERN NEB PANHANDLE. STRONG SURFACE HEATING ACROSS THIS REGION BENEATH COOLER MIDLEVEL TEMPERATURES IS SUPPORTING MODERATE DESTABILIZATION AND A STEEP LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT. THE OVERALL INCREASE IN TSTM DEVELOPMENT WILL PERSIST AS FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO A MIDLEVEL SHORTWAVE TROUGH TRAVERSING THE DAKOTAS SPREADS EWD. EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 35-45 KT WILL SUPPORT ROTATING UPDRAFTS WITH STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES SUPPORTING A HAIL THREAT. DAMAGING WINDS CAN ALSO BE EXPECTED AS DCAPE OF 1500-1900 J/KG AND STEEPENING LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES /9-9.5 C PER KM/ ENHANCE DOWNDRAFT WIND SPEEDS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A RIGHT MOVING SUPERCELL OVER SRN SK IS APPROACHING PARTS OF NERN MT...AND WILL POSE A THREAT FOR HAIL AND LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION WAS DEVELOPING ALONG A BOUNDARY POSITIONED JUST S OF THE INTERNATIONAL BORDER. COVERAGE OF THE THREAT APPEARS TO BE INSUFFICIENT TO SUPPORT A WW...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A RIGHT MOVING SUPERCELL FORMING INVOF A SHORTWAVE UPPER TROUGH WAS LOCATED NEAR THE BORDER OF MT/SK...NEAR STATION CWAQ AS OF 1945Z...WITH A HISTORY OF PRODUCING LARGE HAIL. INSTABILITY REMAINS RATHER MARGINAL DOWNSTREAM FROM THIS STORM...WITH OBJECTIVELY ANALYZED MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 500 J/KG. HOWEVER...SFC OBSERVATIONS REVEAL LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE MAY BE GREATER THAN INDICATED BY MOST FORECAST MODELS...AND MAY CONTRIBUTE TO A SLIGHTLY MORE UNSTABLE ENVIRONMENT THAN SUGGESTED. VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY AND 19Z SFC ANALYSIS SHOW A BOUNDARY EXTENDING EWD FROM A WEAK SFC LOW...WITH THE AFOREMENTIONED SUPERCELL PROPAGATING ALONG THIS BOUNDARY. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION HAS ALSO DEVELOPED WITHIN THE PAST HR ALONG THE BOUNDARY OVER FAR NERN MT. BACKED LOW-LEVEL WINDS INVOF THE BOUNDARY...BENEATH MODERATELY STRONG MIDLEVEL FLOW...IS YIELDING EFFECTIVE SHEAR VALUES OVER 50 KTS...SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS. THIS IS EXPECTED TO MAINTAIN AN ISOLATED THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A FEW STRONG-SVR WIND GUSTS...BUT OVERALL COVERAGE SHOULD BE LIMITED BY WEAK INSTABILITY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED DMGG WIND AND HAIL THREAT WILL EXIST THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NRN GA. IN THE SHORT TERM...COVERAGE APPEARS TO REMAIN TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT WW ISSUANCE ATTM...BUT CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: ISOLATED TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED WITHIN THE PAST COUPLE HRS OVER THE HIGHER TERRAIN OF NRN GA...BUT COVERAGE APPEARS TO BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED BY WEAK MIDLEVEL RIDGING AND LACK OF APPARENT MESOSCALE BOUNDARIES. A HOT AND MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER EXISTS DOWNSTREAM FROM ONGOING CONVECTION...YIELDING MLCAPE VALUES AOA 2000 J/KG. ADDITIONAL CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT THROUGH THE NEXT FEW HRS SHOULD PRIMARILY BE DRIVEN BY STORM-SCALE BOUNDARY INTERACTIONS AND CONVECTIVE MERGERS. A FAVORABLE ENVIRONMENT EXISTS FOR STRONG-SVR WIND GUSTS...GIVEN THE PRESENCE OF STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND DCAPE VALUES AOA 1200 J/KG. STORM ORGANIZATION MAY BE SOMEWHAT LIMITED WITH MIDLEVEL FLOW SAMPLED NEAR 20 KTS PER REGIONAL VWP DATA. ADDITIONALLY...A HAIL THREAT COULD ACCOMPANY THE STRONGEST CONVECTIVE CORES. IT IS UNCLEAR WHETHER UPSTREAM CONVECTION /I.E. OVER ERN TN AND FAR WRN NC/ ACCOMPANYING A WEAK CNTRL APPALACHIANS UPPER IMPULSE WILL BE MAINTAINED INTO PARTS OF NRN GA PRIOR TO DIURNAL COOLING COMMENCEMENT...BUT AN ADDITIONAL /PERHAPS MORE ORGANIZED/ SVR THREAT MAY EVENTUALLY DEVELOP LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THIS REGION WILL BE MONITORED FOR WW ISSUANCE BY 23-00Z. TSTM DEVELOPMENT IS EXPECTED BETWEEN 21-00Z ACROSS CENTRAL INTO SRN MN...WITH A SUBSEQUENT LIKELIHOOD FOR STORMS TO BECOME SEVERE GIVEN THE DEGREE OF AVAILABLE INSTABILITY /MLCAPE OF 2500-3500 J PER KG/. LARGE HAIL...SOME VERY LARGE...AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS ONCE STORMS DEVELOP LATE THIS AFTERNOON AND EARLY EVENING.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG SURFACE HEATING AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT NOW MOVING INTO CENTRAL MN HAS CONTRIBUTED TO VERY STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MLCAPE RANGING FROM 2500-3500 J/KG EXTENDING WWD FROM WEST CENTRAL WI. CONVECTIVE DEVELOPMENT IS AT A MINIMUM AT THE PRESENT TIME ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AS THIS AREA RESIDES BETWEEN TWO SHORTWAVE TROUGHS. HOWEVER...FORCING FOR ASCENT ATTENDANT TO THE PROGRESSIVE DAKOTAS SYSTEM IS LIKELY SUPPORTING CONVECTIVE DEEPER CU FORMATION ALONG THE COLD FRONT IN NERN SD /CLARK COUNTY/ WITH ADDITIONAL CU AND ACCAS FORMATION EWD INTO CENTRAL MN. 12Z NAM/12Z NSSL-4 KM WRF AND THE 16/17Z RUNS OF THE HRRR ALL SUGGEST AT LEAST ISOLATED TSTM DEVELOPMENT INTO CENTRAL MN BY 00Z WITH ACTIVITY MOVING SSEWD. ALTHOUGH EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR IS CURRENTLY WEAK...AN INCREASE IN VALUES DURING THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS AND THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY ARE EXPECTED TO SUPPORT SEVERE STORMS WITH HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE PRIMARY THREATS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS ARE RAPIDLY DEVELOPING OVER SWRN MO AND NWRN/N-CNTRL AR...WITH ADDITIONAL/ISOLATED ACTIVITY POSSIBLY DEVELOPING OVER PORTIONS OF FAR ERN OK DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS. STORMS WILL POSE A THREAT OF DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL AS THEY SPREAD S-SEWD DURING THE EVENING. TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED FOR A WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY SHOWS AN MCV MOVING SEWD ACROSS SWRN MO. SURFACE AIRMASS AHEAD OF THIS FEATURE IS HOT /TEMPERATURES FROM 100-105 F/ AND FAIRLY MOIST /DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE MID 60S/...WHICH IS SUPPORTING MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WITH ESTIMATES OF MLCAPE RANGING FROM 1000-2500 J/KG. AS A RESULT...THUNDERSTORM CLUSTERS HAVE RECENTLY DEVELOPED AHEAD OF THE MCV OVER SWRN MO AND NWRN/N-CNTRL AR. NWLY MIDLEVEL FLOW FROM 20-40 KT RESIDES ALONG THE ERN PERIPHERY OF AN UPPER-LEVEL ANTICYCLONE...WHICH IS CONTRIBUTING TO EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 40 KT ACROSS THE AREA. GIVEN THE STRONG INSTABILITY AND FAVORABLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...ORGANIZED MULTICELL CLUSTERS ACQUIRING BRIEF MIDLEVEL ROTATION WILL BE LIKELY...AND WILL POSE A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL. IF CONFIDENCE IN GREATER SVR COVERAGE INCREASES DURING THE NEXT FEW HRS...THEN THE NEED FOR A WW MAY BECOME NECESSARY.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTER OF SVR TSTMS NEAR RWF WILL LIKELY CONTINUE WITH A THREAT OF WIND DAMAGE THROUGH AT LEAST 03Z. BEYOND THAT...UNCERTAINTY EXISTS DUE TO THE DEGREE TO WHICH THE COLD POOL/SHEAR BALANCE CAN BE MAINTAINED. STRONGER UPDRAFTS WITHIN THIS CLUSTER WILL ALSO HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE LARGE HAIL.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SVR TSTMS VICINITY RWF HAVE DEVELOPED A SMALL COLD POOL AND ARE PRODUCING DAMAGING WINDS...REF G69KT AT RWF...THAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE THROUGH AT LEAST 03Z. ENVIRONMENT AHEAD OF THIS CLUSTER IS CHARACTERIZED BY MLCAPE IN EXCESS OF 3000 J/KG AND A LARGELY UNIDIRECTIONAL WIND PROFILE ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER. SHORT-TERM ENVIRONMENT APPEARS FAVORABLE FOR ADDITIONAL ENHANCED WIND DAMAGE THREAT. BEYOND 03Z...THERE IS SOME QUESTION WHETHER THE COLD POOL/SHEAR BALANCE CAN BE MAINTAINED AND SUSTAIN THE WIND DAMAGE THREAT. IN ADDITION...THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING WILL LIKELY LEAD TO INCREASING CINH WITH TIME LATER THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: GREATEST SVR WEATHER THREAT THIS EVENING FOR WW 546 WILL GENERALLY BE CONFINED TO PORTIONS OF MIDDLE AND SERN TN. ISOLATED SVR STORMS MAY SPREAD SEWD INTO NRN AL AND NRN GA...BUT AN ADDITIONAL WW DOES NOT APPEAR NECESSARY ATTM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AT 0045Z...CLUSTER OF THUNDERSTORMS WAS LOCATED OVER MIDDLE TN...WITH ANOTHER CLUSTER OF STRONG/SVR STORMS POSITIONED OVER FAR SERN TN. THIS ACTIVITY IS GENERALLY MOVING SEWD AT 25 KT...WHICH WILL RESULT IN SERN TN COMPLEX ENTERING NRN GA DURING THE NEXT HR. THE 00Z FFC AND BMX RAOBS SHOW THAT THE COMBINATION OF A VERY HOT AND MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...AS WELL AS MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES FROM 6-7 C/KM...IS AIDING IN STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MUCAPE VALUES IN EXCESS OF 3500 J/KG. THOUGH INSTABILITY WILL DECREASE AS SURFACE AIRMASS COOLS THIS EVENING...A FEW STRONG/SVR THUNDERSTORMS MAY PERSIST DUE TO THE CONTINUED PRESENCE OF AMPLE CAPE AND UPPER SUPPORT FROM A WAVE MOVING SEWD ACROSS KY/TN. THUS...SRN PORTIONS OF WW 546 WILL CONTINUE TO EXPERIENCE A THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL/DAMAGING WIND GUSTS THROUGH 03Z...WITH AT LEAST AN ISOLATED SVR THREAT POSSIBLE S OF THE WATCH OVER NRN AL/GA. ..GARNER.. 08/02/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CLUSTERS OF STG/SVR TSTMS MAY CONTINUE A THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS THROUGH 02Z. THE POTENTIAL FOR A LONGER-LIVED SVR POTENTIAL IS UNCERTAIN HOWEVER TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CLUSTERS OF STG/SVR TSTMS NORTH AND SW OF KONL HAVE DEVELOPED PRONOUNCED BOWING SEGMENTS OVER THE PAST HOUR...HOWEVER RADAR TRENDS FROM KLNX AND KFSD SUGGEST THE OUTFLOW HAS SURGED QUICKLY EWD. THIS...COMBINED WITH INCREASING CINH AS RELATIVELY DRIER AIR IN ADVANCE OF THESE TSTMS COOLS WITH THE LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING...SUGGESTS THAT THESE CLUSTERS WILL NOT POSE A LONGER-TERM SVR THREAT AND THEREFORE A WW IS NOT LIKELY ATTM. HOWEVER...TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SMALL CLUSTER OF SVR TSTMS OVER SERN MN MAY CONTINUE TO POSE A SVR WIND/HAIL THREAT FOR A FEW MORE HOURS AS IT MOVES EWD INTO SWRN WI. CONVECTIVE TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL CLUSTER OF SVR TSTMS OVER SERN MN WILL MOVE GENLY EWD INTO SWRN WI THROUGH 05Z. THE ENVIRONMENT IN THE IMMEDIATE PATH OF THIS CLUSTER IS FAVORABLE FOR A CONTINUED LOCALIZED SVR WIND AND HAIL THREAT. LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS SUGGESTS TSTM CLUSTER IS CURRENTLY MOVING THROUGH AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY WITH MUCAPE 2000 TO 3000 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR OF 25 TO 30 KT. ALTHOUGH THE SVR THREAT IS CURRENTLY RELATIVELY LOCALIZED...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR SIGNS OF A DEVELOPING COLD POOL WHICH WOULD SUGGEST A MORE SUSTAINED SVR THREAT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STG TSTMS DEVELOPING BETWEEN LBF AND HLC WILL HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE ISOLATED SVR WIND GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL THROUGH THE EARLY MORNING HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STG TSTMS DEVELOPING IN THE VICINITY OF A SURFACE TROUGH WILL MOVE EWD AND HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO PRODUCE ISOLATED SVR WINDS AND LARGE HAIL FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS. LATEST OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS OVER THE DISCUSSION AREA INDICATES TSTMS ARE DEVELOPING WITHIN A ZONE OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY...MUCAPES 2500-3500 J/KG AND MODERATELY STRONG WESTERLY MID LEVEL FLOW. ELY LOW-LEVEL WINDS AND AN E-W ORIENTED INSTABILITY AXIS WILL MAXIMIZE INFLOW OF VERY UNSTABLE AIR INTO THE CLUSTER OF STORMS. ALTHOUGH THE 850 MB LOW-LEVEL JET IS FORECAST TO VEER OVERNIGHT...MODEST WARM-AIR ADVECTION WILL BE PRESENT OVER NRN KS/SRN NEB. LATEST NAM CONVECTIVE PRECIP FORECAST ALSO INDICATES THIS CLUSTER OF STORMS WILL PERSIST FOR THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
